homepage.projects.Scott Hu.comment.message: Request libs like fetch and axios make requests very simple, react-query and swr further reduce the template code of requests. But what alova aims to do is to provide extreme API consumption efficiency, eliminating almost all of your request work and achieving more efficient Client-Server data interaction.
